_about: Which price group (Manna Treads item property) an item belongs to when none is ticked, and a local test's stand-in price. Decided with the user on 11 Nov 2026. Two implementations read this file: sap-pricing/AutoGroups.ps1 (Test-AutoGroups.ps1) and sap-b1if/erpnext/manna_sap_pricing.py (test_manna_sap_pricing.py). A ticked property always wins; these cases are for items with none. Type: the SAP item group (HOT -> HOT, PRECURED or PCTR -> PCTR). Quality: the name, else U_SubTypeA; matched as text with spaces removed, so 'POLY GOLD' and 'POLYCOLD' are Polygold. Both naming different qualities, or neither naming one: no group.
